A short paved, wheelchair-accessible trail leads to a viewing platform overlooking Worthington Glacier, often called one of Alaska's most accessible glaciers. Open until closed by winter snow.

attractions.name: Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens

attractions.name: Columbus Zoo and Aquarium

attractions.name: Hocking Hills State Park
